title: watches.yaml — what the triage loop picks up
description: A watch says what to pick up and who owns it. The loop itself is generic; adding a queue is an entry here, not new pipeline code.

id.description: Stable identifier. Appears in every bundle and metrics record, so renaming one breaks history.

jql.description: The query the loop runs. The standard exclusion of the agent:triaged label is added by the runner, not written here.

work_types.description: Work types this watch may dispatch. Anything else exits as 'Not for this loop'.

reporter_group.description: Who receives a Needs Info transition. A missing artifact is assigned here, never left unassigned.

dispatch_state.description: The Jira state whose transition fires the build loop. Absent means this watch triages but never dispatches.

max_blast_radius.description: Above this label the ticket is never dispatched, however green the evidence.

daily_dispatch_cap.description: Hard ceiling on build-loop dispatches per day for this watch. Absent means the runner default applies.

requires.description: Extra artifacts required before build. 'spec' means spec.md must exist and be approved at Gate 1.

mode.description: New watches start as shadow: everything runs but nothing is posted or dispatched.

allOf.description: A live watch that names no dispatch_state can still triage; a watch that dispatches must say into which state.

blast_radius.description: Ordered least to most dangerous. money and protocol are always owner-gated and never auto-merge.
